description: Defines an enumeration `FileFormat` representing various file formats used for key materials, including methods for detecting and using file extensions to determine format.

classes.name: FileFormat
classes.description: An enum representing supported file formats for key materials, with helper methods for detection.

methods.name: orDetect
methods.description: Returns the given format if provided, or attempts to detect the format based on the file path if not.

methods.name: detect
methods.description: Determines the file format based on the file extension in the provided path.
